origin.description: Restricts values to a level set.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Restricts values to a level set.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
collector <- col_factor(c("a", "b"), ordered = TRUE)
paste(class(collector)[1], paste(collector$levels, collapse = ","), yn(collector$ordered), yn(collector$include_na), sep = ";")

translation.description: Restricts values to a level set.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Restricts values to a level set.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
collector = col_factor(["a", "b"], ordered=True)
return "collector_" + collector.kind + ";" + ",".join(collector.fields["levels"]) + ";" + yn(collector.fields["ordered"]) + ";" + yn(collector.fields["include_na"])
